decisions.reason: It has been carried on its own product page across 2023 and 2024, indicating visible commitment and enough prior investment that management would likely continue rather than reverse course quickly.

As a 2024 launch with its own page in the firm’s core LED lighting business, management would likely interpret any weak early results as temporary and persist.
Although more of a system accessory than a flagship luminaire, its dedicated page shows meaningful commitment and its very recent launch favors continued support.
